quests.title: A Little Something for Luck
quests.description: Bring Cecilia the monster parts she requested in exchange for a Worn Lucky Ring.

offerDialogue.npcText: Fate is a strange thing, isn’t it? It brought you to me and I have exactly what you came for. But isn’t it luck, though? Maybe…

npcTextLocales.pt-BR: O destino é algo curioso, não é? Ele trouxe você até mim, e tenho exatamente o que procura. Mas será que é sorte? Talvez…
npcTextLocales.en-US: Fate is a strange thing, isn’t it? It brought you to me and I have exactly what you came for. But isn’t it luck, though? Maybe…

offerDialogue.npcText: Oh yes, darling! You’re talking to the princess jeweler of this world. Just bring me 20x slime gel, 20x Bat Wings and I’ll give you something that’ll bring luck to your journey.

npcTextLocales.pt-BR: Ah, querida! Está falando com a joalheira princesa deste mundo. Traga 20 Géis de Slime, 20 Asas de Morcego e lhe darei algo que trará sorte à sua jornada.
npcTextLocales.en-US: Oh yes, darling! You’re talking to the princess jeweler of this world. Just bring me 20x slime gel, 20x Bat Wings and I’ll give you something that’ll bring luck to your journey.

activeDialogue.npcText: Marvelous, darling! Bring me the parts when you have them, and we shall make a little luck of our own.

npcTextLocales.pt-BR: Maravilhoso, querida! Traga as partes quando as tiver, e faremos nossa própria sorte.
npcTextLocales.en-US: Marvelous, darling! Bring me the parts when you have them, and we shall make a little luck of our own.

completionDialogue.npcText: There you go, darling! May this little ring bring a little more luck to your journey.

npcTextLocales.pt-BR: Aqui está, querida! Que este anel traga um pouco mais de sorte à sua jornada.
npcTextLocales.en-US: There you go, darling! May this little ring bring a little more luck to your journey.

titleLocales.pt-BR: Um Pequeno Presente para a Sorte

descriptionLocales.pt-BR: Traga a Cecilia as partes de monstros que ela pediu em troca de um Anel da Sorte Gasto.
descriptionLocales.en-US: Bring Cecilia the monster parts she requested in exchange for a Worn Lucky Ring.

quests.title: The Forest Ancient’s Teardrops

titleLocales.pt-BR: As Lágrimas do Ancião da Floresta

quests.description: Bring Pajé Piatã five Forest Ancient’s Teardrops to help preserve the balance of the forest.

descriptionLocales.pt-BR: Traga cinco Lágrimas do Ancião da Floresta ao Pajé Piatã para ajudar a preservar o equilíbrio da mata.
descriptionLocales.en-US: Bring Pajé Piatã five Forest Ancient’s Teardrops to help preserve the balance of the forest.

offerDialogue.npcText: Aruandê, traveler. The forest is growing weak. I need five of the ancient’s tears. Will you help?

npcTextLocales.pt-BR: Aruandê, viajante. A floresta está enfraquecendo. Preciso de cinco lágrimas do ancião. Você me ajudará?
npcTextLocales.en-US: Aruandê, traveler. The forest is growing weak. I need five of the ancient’s tears. Will you help?

start.npcText: Aruandê, traveler. The forest is growing weak. I need five of the ancient’s tears. Will you help?

npcTextLocales.pt-BR: Aruandê, viajante. A floresta está enfraquecendo. Preciso de cinco lágrimas do ancião. Você me ajudará?
npcTextLocales.en-US: Aruandê, traveler. The forest is growing weak. I need five of the ancient’s tears. Will you help?

choices.text: What will you do with these tears?

textLocales.pt-BR: O que o senhor fará com essas lágrimas?
textLocales.en-US: What will you do with these tears?

explanation.npcText: The Flaming Treant holds the old memories of this forest. Its tears can help restore the balance.

npcTextLocales.pt-BR: O Treant Flamejante guarda as memórias antigas desta floresta. Suas lágrimas podem ajudar a restaurar o equilíbrio.
npcTextLocales.en-US: The Flaming Treant holds the old memories of this forest. Its tears can help restore the balance.

objectives.description: Collect Forest Ancient’s Teardrops from the Flaming Treant

descriptionLocales.pt-BR: Colete Lágrimas do Ancião da Floresta do Treant Flamejante
descriptionLocales.en-US: Collect Forest Ancient’s Teardrops from the Flaming Treant

activeDialogue.npcText: The Flaming Treant holds the forest’s old memories. Bring me five tears, and guard your steps.

npcTextLocales.pt-BR: O Treant Flamejante guarda as memórias antigas da floresta. Traga-me cinco lágrimas e cuide de seus passos.
npcTextLocales.en-US: The Flaming Treant holds the forest’s old memories. Bring me five tears, and guard your steps.

completionDialogue.npcText: You honored the forest. Take these boots; may they guide you safely.

npcTextLocales.pt-BR: Você honrou a floresta. Fique com estas botas; que elas guiem seus passos em segurança.
npcTextLocales.en-US: You honored the forest. Take these boots; may they guide you safely.
